installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

SERVER_DIR=/mnt/server
APP_ID=${SRCDS_APPID:-4211100}

echo "Installing SCP: ReEnter Dedicated Server (AppID ${APP_ID})..."
mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/steamcmd" "${SERVER_DIR}/steamapps"
cd /tmp
curl -fsSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzf steamcmd.tar.gz -C "${SERVER_DIR}/steamcmd"

# SteamCMD requires a writable HOME and can fail in the installer when /mnt is not owned by root.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME="${SERVER_DIR}"
cd "${SERVER_DIR}/steamcmd"

STEAM_ARGS=()
if [[ -n "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ]]; then
    STEAM_ARGS+=(-beta "${SRCDS_BETAID}")
fi
if [[ -n "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ]]; then
    STEAM_ARGS+=(-betapassword "${SRCDS_BETAPASS}")
fi

./steamcmd.sh +@ShutdownOnFailedCommand 1 +@NoPromptForPassword 1 +force_install_dir "${SERVER_DIR}" +login anonymous +app_update "${APP_ID}" "${STEAM_ARGS[@]}" validate +quit

# Steamworks SDK library expected by the dedicated server.
mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/.steam/sdk32" "${SERVER_DIR}/.steam/sdk64"
cp -f "${SERVER_DIR}/steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so" "${SERVER_DIR}/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so"
if [[ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/linux64/steamclient.so" ]]; then
    cp -f "${SERVER_DIR}/linux64/steamclient.so" "${SERVER_DIR}/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"
else
    cp -f "${SERVER_DIR}/steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so" "${SERVER_DIR}/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so"
fi

if [[ ! -f "${SERVER_DIR}/SCPReEnterServer.sh" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: SteamCMD completed, but SCPReEnterServer.sh was not installed."
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x "${SERVER_DIR}/SCPReEnterServer.sh"
if [[ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/SCPWebPanel" ]]; then
    chmod +x "${SERVER_DIR}/SCPWebPanel"
fi
mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/SCPReEnter/ServerConfig/Global"

echo "SCP: ReEnter Dedicated Server installed successfully."

variables.name: Automatic game updates
variables.description: Checks for and installs a Steam update before every server start. 1 = enabled, 0 = disabled.

variables.name: Validate server files
variables.description: Runs SteamCMD validation during an automatic update. Enable only for troubleshooting because startup will take longer.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name displayed in the SCP: ReEnter server browser. Line breaks are not allowed.

variables.name: Server description
variables.description: Short description or MOTD displayed to players.

variables.name: Maximum players
variables.description: Maximum number of players allowed on the server.

variables.name: Friendly fire
variables.description: Enables or disables friendly-fire damage. Accepted values: True or False.

variables.name: Enable SCP WebPanel
variables.description: Starts the optional SCPWebPanel together with the game server. Add WEB_PANEL_PORT as an additional Pterodactyl allocation first. 1 = enabled, 0 = disabled.

variables.name: WebPanel mode
variables.description: 1 = automatic HTTPS with a self-signed certificate, 2 = custom HTTPS using cert.pem and key.pem, 3 = plain HTTP for a reverse proxy.

variables.name: WebPanel port
variables.description: TCP port for the optional browser WebPanel. It must be assigned to the server as an additional Pterodactyl allocation.

variables.name: Steam branch
variables.description: Optional Steam branch name. Leave empty for the public stable branch.

variables.name: Steam branch password
variables.description: Password for a protected Steam branch. Leave empty for the stable branch.

variables.name: Additional startup arguments
variables.description: Optional raw arguments appended to SCPReEnterServer.sh. Leave empty unless the game documentation asks for an additional flag.

variables.name: Runtime image automatic update switch
variables.description: Internal compatibility variable. The egg performs its own update so the image updater must remain disabled.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: SCP: ReEnter Dedicated Server Steam AppID. Do not change.
